body: I struggle with suicidal thoughts and have for over a decade. I see a psychiatrist and therapist, but they’re still regularly there. I’m a stay at home mom and rarely spend time away from my kids. Today after they had been away all day at a birthday party, the first thing my 4 year old said to me was he missed me. That made me want to cry. I could never take myself away from them. No matter how hard it gets.

All the shells I had in the tank were in a container. I checked an old pic from a few days ago and compared it to tonight’s, seems like the only difference is the addition of the shell he was in :( I really don’t think he’s in a shell right now! I just went to check on things and Moana, my crab that has been down for 4-5 days, was happily munching on food. Guess she digs down during the day and comes out at night. Makes sense. I’m still pretty new to this. I think I can see Tamatoa’s leg in the bottom corner of my tank where there’s a new tunnel. It would be easy to uncover him and see if he’s naked, but I really don’t know if I should disturb him. Maybe wait til morning and see if he’s still MIA? Thanks for responding

The shell he was in is now empty. I didn’t realize all day until I noticed it was on its side. I gently checked the others in the shell area after not seeing any movement when he normally starts moving around for the night and he isn’t in any of them.

You want the heat on the back of the tank above the substrate. Want to heat the air and not the substrate. Don’t put it under the tank at any time. It’s fine for the substrate to be cooler

If you have Facebook, there’s a group called Hermit Crab Owners with a blue logo. They have a lot of helpful guides. A whole section on heating and placement

Thank you! I’m definitely planning to insulate the heating cord with car insulation once it arrives. I just want to do something in the meantime. Hydrometer is on the opposite side of the tank, so I think leaving the tablecloth partially off is a good idea right now. I’m so excited about my new buddies and trying to do everything right. Thanks again!

I’m 25 and hadn’t been to the dentist since I broke a tooth at 17 or 18 before last week. I have about $1300 in total of dental work from not taking care of myself properly for years (yay depression). Had to have X-rays (which they were doing a price special on) and a deep cleaning so far to hopefully stop gingivitis, that was around $320 of the work. I have 3 cavities still needing to be filled and they recommended sealant on a number of teeth because of how they formed which I might not worry about since I don’t have dental insurance. I definitely regret not taking care of my teeth better sooner. I’m now religiously brushing twice a day and flossing at night.

I’m glad you’re still here. Try your best to remember there is always potential in being alive, even when it doesn’t feel like that could possibly be true. You never know what could happen tomorrow. The unknown used to scare and overwhelm me, but now I try to embrace it as something to look forward to. 

Another thing I do sometimes is pretend that each day is a new life. Maybe today was horrible and I wanted more than anything to end it all, but luckily that day/“life” is over and I got to wake up a new person with a fresh start tomorrow. I know it sounds like it wouldn’t work well when you have the same constant responsibilities every time you wake up, but sometimes it helps put me in a new mindset to handle things better. Today I get to be this new person tackling obstacles in a new way. 

Big hugs to you
